# 📩📍 Google Maps Email Extractor

The Apify actor [`lukaskrivka/google-maps-with-contact-details`](https://apify.com/lukaskrivka/google-maps-with-contact-details) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.466**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract Google Maps contact details. Scrape websites of Google Maps places for contact details and get email addresses, website, location, address, zipcode, phone number, social media links. Export scraped data, run the scraper via API, schedule and monitor runs or integrate with other tools.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Scraped place $0.005, Add-on: Filter applied $0.0015, Add-on: Additional place details scraped $0.003, Add-on: Company contacts enrichment $0.0025, Add-on: Business leads enrichment $0.1, Add-on: Email verification $0.1, Add-on: Social media profile enrichment $0.1, Actor Start $0.00005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/lukaskrivka/google-maps-with-contact-details) for current prices.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.
